payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for different models and datasets used in cyberbullying detection, including comparisons of DNN and traditional machine learning models.

claims.text: Oversampling bullying posts improved the performance of DNN models significantly across evaluation measures, particularly for the Formspring dataset.
DNN models outperformed traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) in cyberbullying detection, as shown in comparative performance results.
The Formspring dataset showed higher precision (0.51) and recall (0.66) when using Wikipedia as the base model compared to Twitter, which had lower performance metrics.
